title: A Network Approach to Affect Regulation Dynamics and Personality Trait-Induced Variations: Extraversion and Neuroticism Moderate Reciprocal Influences between Affect and Affect Regulation Strategies
limitations: - Small sample size (n=78); - Reliance on self-reported data; - Limited generalizability due to non-clinical sample; - No formal test of centrality differences between groups; - Potential confounding by age (not controlled for in final models despite being considered)
notes: The study used an experience sampling method with smartphone-based assessments. The network analysis was conducted using multilevel vector autoregressive models in R. The data and code are openly accessible on OSF. The authors note that the correlation between extraversion and neuroticism was unexpected and may require caution in interpretation. No formal centrality tests were conducted.
